newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Limestone County, Ala.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Limestone County, Ala.

text.p: Board of Education of Limestone County,
Capital Outlay Tax Anticipation Warrants, Series 1997

THE BOARD OF EDUCATION OF LIMESTONE COUNTY, ALABAMA (the Board''), is inviting sealed bids for the purchase from it of $5,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its Capital Outlay Tax Anticipation Warrants, Series 1997 (the
Warrants''), such sealed bids to be opened at the office of the Board at 300 South Jefferson Street, Athens, Alabama, at 11:00 o'clock, A.M., Athens, Alabama time, on Thursday,

The Warrants will mature serially in the years 1997 through 2016, inclusive, will not be general obligations of the Board, will be payable as to both principal and interest solely from that portion of the proceeds of a special privilege or license and excise tax (commonly called a sales and use tax'') that is paid, apportioned and allocated to the Board, and will be subject to redemption prior to their respective maturities, all as specified in the Official Invitation for Bids respecting the Warrants. The Warrants will be secured, on a parity basis with certain outstanding warrants of the Board, by a pledge of so much as may be necessary therefor of said portion of said tax proceeds so paid, apportioned and allocated to the Board. The Board will furnish to the successful bidder for the Warrants, without cost, the printed Warrants and the

approving legal opinion of Balch & Bingham LLP, Birmingham, Alabama, Bond Counsel, with respect to the Warrants. A copy of an Official Statement respecting the Warrants, the Official Invitation for Bids and the Official Bid Form with respect to the Warrants may be obtained from Joe Jolly & Co., Inc., 520 First Alabama Bank Building, Birmingham, Alabama 35203, telephone (205) 252-2105.
BOARD OF EDUCATION OF LIMESTONE COUNTY,
